metadata.title: Natal + Daily Backend Slice Development Plan
metadata.scope: High-risk backend/core execution waves for natal generation reliability and daily/day-brief quality.

executionRules.rule: Do not ship product features; only reliability, contract, validator, fallback, and repair hardening inside the defined slice.
Each wave must keep the slice green on its minimal targeted verification profile before advancing.
When a bug is reproduced, add or update a targeted regression first, then fix, then rerun the targeted bundle to PASS.
Prefer deterministic truth-path fixes over prompt-only mitigation.

wave.goal: Stabilize natal section context and summary-layer truth paths.

tasks.task: Pin summary-layer acceptance rules against the existing runtime contract for `executive_summary` and `final_synthesis`.
Confirm fallback entry points prefer deterministic insight-pack content over generic template leakage.

deliverables.item: Stable semantic coordinates for natal truth paths.
Targeted regression updates only where a reproducible gap exists.

verificationRefs.ref: `docker exec astro-project-backend-1 python3 -m pytest -q tests/verify_natal_generation.py tests/test_validation_relaxed.py tests/test_validation_template_fallback.py tests/test_report_contract.py`

wave.goal: Bound validator/repair behavior for natal generation failures.

tasks.task: Trace `generate_section_content`, validator calls, and fallback selection rules for bounded LLM/runtime failures.
Eliminate user-visible repair leakage and generic fallback blocks in summary-layer output.
Keep fallback blocks readable and contract-compatible when malformed content remains visible.

verificationRefs.ref: `docker exec astro-project-backend-1 python3 -m pytest -q tests/verify_natal_generation.py tests/test_validation_template_fallback.py tests/test_validation_relaxed.py`

wave.goal: Harden day-brief schema, validators, and repair path.

tasks.task: Map the exact accepted payload contract in `day_brief_types` and `day_brief_validators`.
Constrain repair/fallback behavior so malformed model output becomes schema-safe or explicit failure, never silent drift.
Preserve compatibility for current day-brief/report consumers.

verificationRefs.ref: `docker exec astro-project-backend-1 python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_day_brief.py tests/test_day_brief_schema.py`

wave.goal: Keep `/api/feed/today` factual, deterministic, and auth-safe under fallback.

tasks.task: Verify `build_personalized_daily_facts()` remains the first truth path before prompt execution.
Protect stable response shape and `traffic_lights` semantics across ready/fallback/empty/error paths.
Verify auth-safe logging and safe personalization summaries.

verificationRefs.ref: `docker exec astro-project-backend-1 python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_daily_feed_robustness.py tests/test_personalized_daily_service.py tests/verify_daily_feed.py`

wave.goal: Produce coder-ready handoff with frozen scope, write scope, and required PASS evidence.

tasks.task: Document exact allowed files and forbidden files.
Document PASS gates and unresolved known gaps that remain outside this slice.
Require exact commands and artifact references in worker handoff.
